sections.heading: Local Rubbish Removal for Bondi NSW 2026

blocks.text: Bondi sits about 7 km east of the Sydney CBD, between Bondi Junction and Bondi Beach. It is part of Waverley Council. Bondi Road runs through the middle as the main shopping strip, and the streets around it are lined with heritage and Federation homes, old walk up flats and newer unit blocks.

[The 2021 Census](https://www.abs.gov.au/census/find-census-data/quickstats/2021/SAL10462) counted about 10,400 people in Bondi. Close to 8 in 10 homes are flats or apartments, and more than half of all homes are rented. The median age is 34, and about half of locals were born overseas. One more number stands out. More than 1 in 5 Bondi homes have no car at all.
So a lot of people here move often, live in small spaces and have no easy way to get to the tip. We built our Bondi service to solve all three.
Rented Flat and Unit Rubbish Collection

Moving out of a Bondi rental can be stressful. Your bond depends on a clean, empty home, and the old couch will not fit on the bus. Some renters also have flat pack furniture they would rather not take to the next place.

We clear what you are leaving behind, from one bed frame to a full flat, and our team does all the stair work. Book us a day or two before your final inspection so there is time to clean. See how our [end of lease rubbish removal](/end-of-lease-rubbish-removal) service works.
Heritage Terrace and Semi Rubbish Removal

Bondi's older terraces and semis are full of character, but they can be hard to clear. Halls are narrow, stairs are steep, and some homes only have rear lane access. A wardrobe that came in years ago may not want to come out.

Our crew takes care with old floors, walls and doorways. We can take apart large items when needed and carry everything out by hand. Have a look at our [unwanted furniture removal](/unwanted-furniture-removal) service for the kinds of items we take.

sections.heading: Waverley Council Clean Up or a Private Hard Rubbish Collection?

blocks.text: Waverley Council offers [free clean up collections](https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/waste_and_recycling/book_a_clean-up_collection)for bulky household items. Each home gets one scheduled collection plus two “Your Call” bookings per calendar year. Here are the key rules:

items: Each collection is limited to 2 cubic metres. That is a pile 2 metres long, 1 metre wide and 1 metre high.
Mattresses are capped at 2 singles or 1 larger mattress per collection.
Council will not take items that need more than two people to lift, such as gym equipment, carpet rolls and glass.
Bricks, tiles, concrete and other building materials are not accepted.
Loose green waste, soil and turf are not taken.

blocks.text: Timing matters too. Items without a confirmed booking are treated as illegal dumping, and Waverley says on the spot fines [can reach $8,000 for individuals and $16,000 for businesses](https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/waste_and_recycling/illegal_dumping).

The council service is great for a small, light pile that can wait. A private pickup suits everything else. That includes a heavy treadmill, a bathroom full of old tiles, a full flat on moving day, or a fourth pickup after all three for the year are gone.

sections.heading: Strata Rubbish Removal for Bondi Apartment Blocks

blocks.text: With so many units in Bondi, shared spaces fill up fast. More are on the way too. Next door in Bondi Junction, council has approved a [masterplan for at least 3,000 new homes](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-07-22/nsw-bondi-junction-homes-waverley-council-masterplan/106943174). Bin rooms, garages and storage cages collect broken furniture and old boxes that no one claims.

This is a real cost for owners. Waverley Council says it [may seek to recover costs from strata](https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/waste_and_recycling/waste_management_for_apartments) that do not contain illegal dumping caused by residents. Regular clear outs help stop that from happening.

We work with building managers, strata committees and real estate agents. We clear common areas, carry items up from basements and leave the space swept. Learn more about our [strata rubbish removal](/strata-rubbish-removal) service.

National Rubbish Removal is a fully licensed waste carrier with public liability insurance. We are [Cm3 certified](https://cm3.com.au/contractors), which means our licences, insurance and safety practices have been independently checked. We are also [ISO certified](https://www.iso.org/certification.html), so the way we run our business meets international standards.

sections.heading: Recycle It Saturday for Batteries, E Waste and Old Clothes

blocks.text: We do not take electronic waste or batteries, but there is a free option for Bondi locals. Waverley, the City of Sydney and Woollahra run [Recycle It Saturday](https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/residents/waste_and_recycling/dispose_of_tricky_household_waste) at the Alexandra Canal Depot, 67C Bourke Road, Alexandria. Events run a few times a year, usually from 9am to 3pm; check the council page for the next date and bring proof of your address.

You can drop off old electronics, batteries, light globes, paint in sealed tins, gas bottles and clothes too worn to donate. Mattresses and white goods are not accepted, but we can take those for you.

Please keep batteries out of your bins. Waverley Council has warned of a [spike in garbage truck fires](https://www.waverley.nsw.gov.au/top/news_and_media/media_releases/all/2024/spike_in_garbage_truck_fires_prompts_safety_warning_for_battery_disposal) caused by batteries crushed inside trucks.

sections.heading: Concrete Removal After Renovations

blocks.text: Removing an old path, replacing pavers or updating a property can produce more concrete than expected. Once the breaking-up work is complete, concrete removal helps clear the resulting pieces so the next stage of landscaping or building can begin.

Let us know whether the material is loose, stacked or spread across the site. Approximate pile size and photos help us assess the weight and access before collection. We do not treat intact slabs or structural concrete as ordinary loose rubble, so any dismantling work should be discussed separately.

sections.heading: Concrete Rubble Removal From Accessible Areas

blocks.text: Concrete rubble removal does not require you to carry every piece to the street. Our team can collect from a backyard, driveway, garage or other accessible area, subject to a safe route for moving the material.

sections.heading: Brick and Rubble Removal for Property Projects

blocks.text: Loose bricks may come from a renovation, an old garden feature or a nonstructural element that has already been dismantled. Brick and rubble removal can clear these materials along with suitable tiles, pavers and other approved masonry debris.

If some bricks are being kept for reuse, separate or clearly mark them before collection. This is particularly helpful when usable supplies and discarded rubble are stored in the same area. Our team will collect the items you have identified for removal.

sections.heading: Where the Rubble Goes

blocks.text: Suitable brick and concrete may be accepted by recycling facilities for processing into other materials. We prioritise that route where possible, with remaining waste handled at an appropriate facility.

Our broader [rubbish removal services](/services) can also collect other approved renovation waste or bulky junk removal items. Asbestos or fibro cement sheeting, contaminated material, wet concrete and silica are excluded, so do not mix them into a brick or concrete pile.

sections.heading: Willoughby Council Clean Up or a Private Hard Rubbish Collection?

blocks.text: Willoughby City Council offers a free [kerbside bulky waste clean up](https://www.willoughby.nsw.gov.au/Residents/Waste-and-recycling/Kerbside-bulky-waste-clean-up-collections). It is a good service if you can plan ahead. Here is how it works:

items: Each home gets three scheduled clean ups and one free booked clean up each calendar year.
Each collection is capped at 2 cubic metres, and no item can be longer than 2 metres.
The crew only takes items that two people can lift safely.
Council suggests booking at least a month ahead to get the date you want.
Every pile needs a clean up label. Items put out before the Sunday night of your collection week count as illegal dumping.
Cancel a booked collection within 7 days of the date and you lose your free booking until next year.
Commercial waste is not accepted.

blocks.text: Do not add your items to a neighbour's pile either. Council treats that as illegal dumping too, with a fine of $4,000.

There is one more thing to know. Council says most clean up material ends up in landfill. Every load we collect goes to licensed Sydney sorting and transfer facilities, and up to 95% of what we collect is recycled or donated where possible.

So the council service suits a small, light pile with a date coming up. A private hard rubbish collection suits everything else: a load bigger than 2 cubic metres, heavy items, rubbish that needs to go this week, or a unit with no kerb of its own.

Got old TVs, laptops, paint or batteries? Take them to the free [Community Recycling Centre](https://willoughby.nsw.gov.au/Residents/Waste-and-recycling/Reduce-reuse-recycle/Community-Recycling-Centre-Northern-Sydney) at 8 Waltham Street, Artarmon. skip-bin-alternatives.sub: Our Sydney skip bin alternatives include loading on site, with no council permit required.
skip-bin-alternatives.title: Skip Bin Alternatives Sydney
skip-bin-alternatives.description: Hard rubbish collection. No council permit required. No skip left on the driveway. Same day pick up available. Call 0489 043 888 for a free quote.

sections.heading: Skip Bin Alternatives Without the Heavy Lifting

blocks.text: A skip bin gives you somewhere to put waste, but you still have to load it yourself. If there is no suitable space on your property, placing a skip on the street may also involve council permits. For a completed cleanout, renovation or property clearance, that can mean carrying heavy items outside and spending hours loading a bin before it is collected.

[National Rubbish Removal](/) offers one of the practical skip bin alternatives for jobs where the unwanted items are ready to go. Our team arrives with a truck, loads the approved items and takes them away, without leaving a bin behind or needing a permit.

sections.heading: When a Skip Bin Alternative Makes Sense

blocks.text: A skip bin alternative can be useful when you need bulky items removed but do not want a bin occupying the driveway or another part of the property. It also removes the need to do the lifting and loading yourself.

The choice depends on the job. A skip may suit work that generates waste gradually over several days. A collection is often more convenient when the rubbish has already accumulated, you want it gone in one visit, or items are too awkward for you to load safely.

sections.heading: An Alternative to Skip Bin Hire for Mixed Waste

blocks.text: A home or business cleanout rarely produces just one kind of item. Furniture, mattresses, packaging, renovation debris and general clutter can all need attention at the same time.

As an alternative to skip bin hire, our service lets you identify the approved items for removal and leave the physical work to our team. We collect from accessible rooms, garages, yards and work areas, rather than asking you to carry everything outside first. Our broader [rubbish removal services](/services) cover many of these common mixed loads.

sections.heading: Skip Bin vs Rubbish Removal

blocks.text: When weighing up skip bin vs rubbish removal, consider more than the space available for waste. Think about who will load it, how long it needs to stay on site, what access is available and when you need the area cleared.

Permit requirements for a skip can also depend on where it is placed. A truck collection avoids leaving a bin on site, though the best option still depends on your property and the work underway. If you are unsure, describe the items and timing when requesting a quote.

sections.heading: What Happens After Collection

blocks.text: Our team sorts suitable items for donation or recycling where possible. Remaining approved waste is taken to an appropriate facility. The areas we clear are swept before we leave.

Like any removal service, there are materials we cannot take, including asbestos, hazardous waste, wet concrete and other excluded items. Mention anything unusual when you enquire so the quote reflects what can actually be collected.

sections.heading: Find the Right Option for Your Job

blocks.text: Whether you are clearing a single bulky item or several areas of a property, the useful starting point is a clear description of what needs to go. Photos help us assess mixed rubbish, access and the approximate size of the collection.
Complete the free quote form or [contact our team](/contact) for a quote. We'll help you decide whether a loaded collection is the right fit for your job.

sections.heading: Strata Rubbish Removal for Managed Properties

blocks.text: Keeping a strata property clear and presentable requires more than relying on ordinary council collections. Abandoned furniture, overflowing storage areas and bulky household items can quickly become problems for residents, visitors and building management.

[National Rubbish Removal](/) provides strata rubbish removal for apartment buildings, townhouse complexes and other shared residential properties. We assist with individual collections, larger property cleanouts and recurring services based on the needs of the building.

sections.heading: Strata Waste Removal Without Unnecessary Disruption

blocks.text: Every strata property has its own access arrangements and building requirements. Our team can coordinate with strata managers, building managers, caretakers and other nominated contacts before collection.

This may include confirming access times, arranging lift use, working around loading areas and following reasonable instructions for protecting common property. We collect items from apartments, storage cages, garages and shared spaces, so residents or building staff do not need to move everything to the street.

sections.heading: Apartment Rubbish Removal for Residents and Managers

blocks.text: Our apartment rubbish removal service can collect furniture, mattresses, whitegoods, boxes, computers, general clutter and other nonhazardous items. Collections can be arranged for a single apartment or multiple areas within the same property.

Apartment access can make bulky items particularly difficult to remove. Narrow corridors, lifts, stairs and restricted parking all require planning. Providing access details when requesting a quote helps us organise the collection properly and avoid unnecessary delays on arrival.

sections.heading: Common Area Rubbish Removal

blocks.text: Items left in foyers, hallways, bin rooms, car parks and shared storage areas can obstruct access and affect the appearance of the property. Common area rubbish removal helps strata representatives deal with these items promptly before they attract further dumping.

We can assist with abandoned furniture, packaging, discarded household goods and other approved waste. Our team handles the lifting and loading, then sweeps the cleared area so it is ready for residents to use again.

sections.heading: One Off and Recurring Rubbish Removal

blocks.text: Some properties need help after a move, renovation or large building clean up. Others benefit from scheduled junk removal to prevent bulky waste from accumulating around bin rooms and common areas.

Our [commercial rubbish removal services](/services) can be arranged as a one off collection or on a recurring basis. Suitable items are sorted for donation or recycling where possible, while remaining waste is taken to an appropriate facility. Larger furniture and appliances can also be included as part of a hard rubbish removal collection.

sections.heading: Request a Strata Collection Quote

blocks.text: Pricing depends on the items involved, access conditions and the requirements of the property. We provide clear quotes without locking every building into the same collection format.
Complete the free quote form or [contact our team](/contact) with photos, item details and access information. We can then recommend a suitable approach for your strata property.

sections.heading: Local Rubbish Removal for Sutherland NSW 2232

blocks.text: Sutherland is about 26 km south of the Sydney CBD and is home to Sutherland Shire Council, with its main offices on Eton Street. Sutherland station is where the Cronulla line splits from the Illawarra line. The suburb also sits beside the Woronora River and Prince Edward Park, with the Royal National Park just to the south.

Most people here live close to the centre. [The 2021 Census](https://abs.gov.au/census/find-census-data/quickstats/2021/SAL13716) shows about two thirds of Sutherland homes are flats or apartments, and around 1 in 7 are townhouses or semis. About 4 in 10 homes are rented, and the average household has 2.1 people.
That means a lot of small homes, a lot of moving days and not much storage. Our Sutherland rubbish removal service is set up for exactly that kind of job.
Town Centre Unit and Townhouse Rubbish Collection

Sutherland is about to grow even more. The NSW Government has taken over planning for the Sutherland and Kirrawee area to allow more homes. In October 2026, [The Leader reported](https://www.theleader.com.au/story/9363765/sutherland-22-storey-tower-fast-tracked-as-traders-push-back/) that a 22 storey tower with 110 apartments on the Old Princes Highway has been fast tracked.

The same report shows what locals already know. Traffic near the rail crossing can be gridlocked from 3pm to 5pm, and some back lanes are very narrow. We plan around this. Where we can, we book town centre pickups in the morning, park close and keep the job short.

Renting and about to move out? We clear everything you are leaving behind, so the place is ready for your final inspection. See our [end of lease rubbish removal](/end-of-lease-rubbish-removal) service.
Homes Near the Woronora River and Bushland

Some homes near Sutherland back onto the Woronora River and the bush. These properties can have steep driveways, long paths and tricky access for big items. Council also lists Woronora River properties as excluded from its pre booked clean up service.
If that sounds like your home, we can help. We carry rubbish up steps and along paths to the truck, so you do not have to.

Garden waste needs extra care near bushland. Sutherland Shire Council asks residents [not to throw garden waste into bushland](https://sutherlandshire.nsw.gov.au/your-environment/bushcare/weeds), because it spreads weeds. Our [green waste removal](/green-waste-removal) team takes cuttings, branches and leaves away so they are handled the right way.

sections.heading: Sutherland Shire Council Clean Up or a Private Hard Rubbish Collection?

blocks.text: Sutherland Shire Council runs a free [pre booked clean up service](https://www.sutherlandshire.nsw.gov.au/living-here/waste-and-recycling/book-a-clean-up). Here are the rules that matter most:

items: Each property can book up to two clean ups per financial year.
Your booking is only confirmed once you get a booking reference number.
In busy periods, the wait can be more than 8 weeks.
If you cancel or change your date within 7 days of collection, it still counts as one of your two clean ups.
Items go out neatly on the kerb the night before your date. Putting them out earlier may lead to a fine.
Mattresses and white goods must be kept apart from the rest, because a separate truck collects them.

blocks.text: It is a good service if you can plan ahead. But if you have already used both clean ups, missed your 7 day window, or simply cannot wait two months, a private pickup is the easy answer. We come at a time that suits you, and nothing has to sit on the kerb.

sections.heading: How Much Does Rubbish Removal Cost in Sutherland?

blocks.text: Our minimum pickup is {{price.household}} for up to 1 m³ of household rubbish. Household rubbish removal starts at {{price.household}}, and shops and offices near the station pay our commercial load prices, from {{price.commercial}} for 2 m³. Labour, loading, cleanup and disposal are all included in the price.

You can get a quick figure from our [online price estimator](/quote-estimator). No skip bin, no permit and no lifting is needed. See how we compare on the [skip bin alternatives](/skip-bin-alternatives) page.

sections.heading: Quick Answers about Sutherland Junk Removal

blocks.q: Can you collect rubbish in Sutherland today?
blocks.a: Usually, yes. Book in the morning or early afternoon and we can often offer same day rubbish removal in Sutherland.

blocks.q: What is the best way to get rid of an old fridge?
blocks.a: Let us carry it out for you. Fridges are heavy and awkward, and council clean ups need them kept separate on the kerb. We take them straight from your kitchen or garage and send the metal for recycling where possible.

blocks.q: Can you avoid the afternoon traffic near the station?
blocks.a: Yes. Tell us if your street gets busy, and we will book a morning time slot when we can.

blocks.q: Do you work across the rest of the Sutherland Shire?
blocks.a: Yes. We also have local pages for [Miranda](/miranda) and [Cronulla](/cronulla), and we work in Kirrawee, Jannali, Gymea, Loftus, Engadine and every other Shire suburb.

sections.heading: Timber Removal That Frees Up Working Space

blocks.text: Timber has a way of spreading across a project. Offcuts collect near the saw, old shelving leans against a wall, and dismantled fittings end up in a garage or yard until someone has time to deal with them.

[National Rubbish Removal](/) provides timber removal for homes, businesses and renovation sites across Sydney. We collect approved loose timber and suitable nonstructural items, handle the loading and take the unwanted material away.

sections.heading: Timber Waste Removal During Renovations

blocks.text: Renovations can leave a mixture of cut lengths, old cabinetry, shelving, skirting and packaging timber. Timber waste removal can be arranged during the work or once the project is finished, depending on when the material starts taking up space.

You do not need to cut every piece into bin-sized lengths. Tell us about long, heavy or awkward items when requesting a quote so we can assess how they will be carried through the property and loaded safely.

sections.heading: Wood Waste Removal Beyond the Building Site

blocks.text: Not all wood waste comes from construction. Broken furniture, worn storage units, old garden structures and leftover timber from home projects can sit unused for years.

Our wood waste removal service helps clear those items from accessible areas such as sheds, garages and backyards. If the collection also includes unwanted furniture, packaging or other approved clutter, our wider [rubbish removal services](/services) may allow them to be handled in the same job.

sections.heading: Keep Useful Timber Separate

blocks.text: A board left over from a renovation may still be useful, while the damaged pieces beside it are ready to go. Before collection, set aside anything you plan to reuse and identify what should be removed.

That simple step matters on active sites as well as at home. It prevents new materials from being mistaken for waste and makes it easier for our team to work efficiently. Nails, screws and sharp edges should also be mentioned when they are present, particularly in dismantled frames or fittings.

sections.heading: Responsible Handling of Timber Waste

blocks.text: Suitable timber may be accepted for reuse or recycling, depending on its condition and the facilities available. We sort materials for those options where possible rather than assuming every piece belongs in general waste.

Timber contaminated with hazardous material needs a different approach and should be identified before collection. Our team can also handle suitable mixed loads that include hard rubbish removal or general junk removal, provided the materials fall within the service’s accepted waste types.

sections.heading: Arrange a Timber Collection

blocks.text: The amount of timber, length of the pieces and access to the pile all affect the job. Photos are useful if the material is spread between several rooms or stored behind a property.
Complete the free quote form or [contact our team](/contact) to discuss your timber removal needs. We'll provide a quote based on the material ready for collection.

sections.heading: Clear Bulky Furniture Without Moving It Yourself

blocks.text: Furniture is easy to bring into a property one piece at a time, but much harder to remove when several items need to go. Sofas, wardrobes, dining tables, cabinets and bed frames can be heavy, awkward and difficult to transport safely. Our unwanted furniture removal service handles the lifting and collection, so you do not need to hire a vehicle, organise a skip or ask friends to help.

sections.heading: Furniture We Commonly Collect

blocks.text: Our old furniture removal service can help with lounges, armchairs, tables, chairs, wardrobes, drawers, shelving, desks, bed frames and other unwanted pieces. Collections can include a single bulky item or furniture from several rooms.

Furniture rubbish removal is particularly useful when moving, downsizing, replacing an old setting, clearing a rental property or preparing rooms for renovation. sections.heading: What Happens to the Furniture

blocks.text: Not every unwanted item needs to be treated as general waste. Furniture in suitable condition may be separated for donation, while recyclable materials are directed to appropriate facilities where possible. Items that cannot be reused or recycled are disposed of responsibly.

sections.heading: Warehouse Rubbish Removal for Clearer Work Areas

blocks.text: Warehouses can accumulate damaged stock, pallets, packaging, broken equipment and unused fixtures faster than standard waste services can handle them. When these materials begin occupying aisles, loading areas or storage bays, they can interfere with everyday operations.

sections.heading: Warehouse Waste Removal

blocks.text: Our warehouse waste removal service can collect packaging, shelving, furniture, pallets, stock, computers, fixtures and other approved nonhazardous materials. Larger items, machinery and industrial equipment may also be collected where they can be safely accessed, handled and transported.

Accurate item details are important for heavy or oversized equipment. Photos, dimensions and information about available lifting or loading access help us assess the job and organise suitable resources before arrival.

sections.heading: Industrial Rubbish Removal With Site Coordination

blocks.text: Industrial rubbish removal often requires more planning than a standard household collection. Warehouses may have active loading docks, forklift traffic, restricted work zones and specific site safety procedures.

Our team can coordinate with warehouse managers, property managers and other nominated contacts to confirm access and collection timing. Work can be arranged in stages where clearing the entire area at once would interfere with normal operations.

sections.heading: Complete Warehouse Cleanout Services

blocks.text: A warehouse cleanout may be required at the end of a lease, after a stock change, before refurbishment or when years of unused material need to be cleared. We can work through storage areas, offices, loading zones and other accessible parts of the property.
Items being kept should be clearly identified before collection begins. Our team then handles the lifting, loading and rubbish removal, reducing the amount of labour required from your own staff.

sections.heading: Recycling and Responsible Disposal

blocks.text: Warehouse clearances often contain materials that can be separated rather than sent away as mixed waste. Suitable metal, timber, furniture, equipment and other materials are directed towards donation or recycling where possible.

Our complete [commercial rubbish removal services](/services) can combine general junk removal with hard rubbish removal for bulky fixtures and equipment. Any excluded or hazardous materials require an appropriate specialist service and should be identified before collection.

sections.heading: Request a Warehouse Removal Quote
